title: Perturbed Beta Corners Process
summary: We introduce and study the perturbed $β$-corners process, a deformation of the classical $β$-corners process. The latter is a probability measure on interlacing arrays of real numbers that, for the classical values $β=1,2,4$, describes the joint distribution of eigenvalues of principal submatrices of a Gaussian random matrix with the corresponding GOE/GUE/GSE symmetry. For classical $β$, the perturbed process arises from adding a deterministic diagonal matrix $A=diag(a_1,...,a_N)$ to a GOE/GUE/GSE matrix. The eigenvalues of the resulting random matrix depend symmetrically on $a_1,...,a_N$,…
